title: Root help breaks custom callbacks expecting command constructors
instruction: The lightweight root-help path passes static command metadata to existing custom help callbacks, which expect constructable command classes. Restore that callback contract while keeping ordinary root help lightweight and keeping per-command help scoped to the selected command.
acceptance_criteria: Existing custom root-help callbacks receive constructable commands.
Ordinary root help avoids loading command implementations and per-command help loads only its selected command.
Root help retains supported option and command summaries.
